Heading: Information we collect
Paragraphs (one per line): We collect only the information you choose to give us when you contact us: typically your name, phone number, email address, company name, the service you are interested in and your message.

Heading: Purpose of collection
Paragraphs (one per line): We use this information solely to respond to your enquiry and, if you engage us, to provide professional services. We do not sell or rent personal information, and we do not use it for unsolicited marketing.

Heading: Enquiry form
Paragraphs (one per line):
When the enquiry form is connected, submissions are delivered to {firm} through a third-party form service, which processes the data on our behalf. If you choose WhatsApp or email instead, your message is handled by that service under its own terms.
Please do not send PAN, Aadhaar, bank details or other sensitive documents through the website form.

Heading: Cookies and tracking
Paragraphs (one per line): This website does not use analytics or advertising cookies. Your browser stores a small preference to remember that you accepted the entry disclaimer. Fonts are served from this website, not from third parties.

Heading: Third-party services
Paragraphs (one per line): Links to WhatsApp, Google Maps, LinkedIn and other external sites take you to services that have their own privacy policies. The office map is loaded from Google only if you click “Show map”.

Heading: Data retention and security
Paragraphs (one per line): Enquiries are kept only as long as needed to respond and for any related engagement, or as required by law. We take reasonable steps to protect information in our possession.

Heading: Your choices
Paragraphs (one per line): You can ask us to see, correct or delete personal information you have sent us by writing to {email}.

Heading: No solicitation
Paragraphs (one per line): This website is meant only to provide information about {firm} to those who seek it. It is not intended to solicit work or advertise, in keeping with the rules of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.

Heading: Not professional advice

Please consult us before acting on any information here. No client relationship is created by using this website or contacting us through it.

Heading: External links
Paragraphs (one per line): Links to third-party websites are provided for convenience. We are not responsible for their content or practices.
